opportunities.name: Cross-timezone meeting sync brief
opportunities.description: For two cities {city_a} and {city_b}, look up the time difference on timeanddate's Time Zone Converter, check public holidays in {holiday_country} for {month}, and email ops a sync note with the offset and the dates to avoid.
steps: Open timeanddate.com and go to Time Zones > Time Zone Converter
Type {city_a} in 'Search for city or time zone...' and pick the matching suggestion
Type {city_b} in the same search box and pick the matching suggestion
Read off the hour offset between the two cities
Go to Calendar > Holidays and observances worldwide
Choose {holiday_country} (from the country list or the letter index) and open its full holiday list for the year
Note the public holidays in {month}
In mail, open New message and set To = {recipient}
Set Subject = 'Sync: {city_a} / {city_b}, {month}'
Set Body = '{city_b} is {offset} hours ahead from {city_a}. Avoid: {holiday_dates}.'
Send the draft (the user discarded it in the recording)

opportunities.name: Company account brief from SEC EDGAR + Wikipedia
opportunities.description: For a stock ticker {ticker}, find the company in SEC EDGAR full-text search, filter its filings to 10-K annual reports, look up the company on Wikipedia (HQ, employee count, CEO), and email {recipient} a short account brief.
steps: Open EDGAR full-text search
Clear the 'Company name, ticker, CIK number or individual's name' field, type {ticker}, and pick the matching company suggestion
Click SEARCH if results don't refresh on their own
In 'Refine search results by', expand Form and click '10-K Annual report'
Note the filing date of the latest 10-K
On Wikipedia, search for {company_name} and open the company article
Note the HQ city, employee count and CEO from the infobox
In mail, open New message with To = {recipient}
Set Subject = 'Account brief: {company_name} ({ticker})'
Set Body = '{company_name}: HQ {hq}, {employees} employees, CEO {ceo}. Latest 10-K filed {date}.'
Send the draft (the user discarded it in the recording)
